`—` means NOT covered and must not be read as equivalent or safe. `LIB` means the mechanism is tested as a library, not enforced inside that protocol's production gate.

## Runtime

- CPython (CI default) on Linux, in-process: yes
- other Python versions: no matrix (P14-11 open)
- macOS / Windows: no
- containers / separate processes: no
- real network transports / live servers: no (all synthetic)

## Outcomes

- ALLOW: tested
- DENY: tested
- REVIEW: tested
- UNKNOWN / UNVERIFIED: tested for epistemic (P16) and contracts (P19); not for parity
- irreversible partial effect: P17 synthetic KV only
